name: Fine Print

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You Strike and deal damage to an Off-Guard creature with your contract blade.

---
The text of the contracts written across your papery blade contain hidden clauses that can cause great pain for an unsuspecting foe. You deal an additional 2d4 precision damage to the off-guard creature.
